title: A HOT Crypto Project - Strongblock
description: Just another source of passive income ya feel?! #shorts.

asr.full_text: Exactly 10 days ago I spent $24,000 on 4 nodes on the StrongBlock network, Now each node you buy will make you some passive income, you just have to pay a monthly maintenance fee of $15 per node, And so far I've made $2,000 back in 10 days, which is pretty good. That means it'll take me about 90 more days to make all my money back And then it's just free passive income.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes buying StrongBlock nodes and paying recurring per-node fees as a route to passive income. The speaker claims $2,000 was returned in ten days and that the initial $24,000 could be recovered in about 90 more days, while an overlay links a $2,000 claim to Ethereum node rewards. These payment-to-return claims are presented in a first-person promotional or testimonial frame.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The speaker links purchasing StrongBlock nodes and paying per-node maintenance fees to recurring passive income. He reports a past return and projects a future payback period.
